review_context.method: The reviewer verified the original pinned PDF and table visuals before reading all five catalogues, 109 owned files and 81 executions. Canonical premises, assertions, byte lengths, exact case sets and author fingerprints were checked. Compiler observations were consulted only after source and fixture review; the reviewer did not run compilers or record approvals.
review_context.integration: The coordinator applied the two required corrections, implemented and exercised the reporting contract below, and refreshed all affected observations. This receipt condenses the original review and records those subsequent changes separately.

6.1.5.rationale: All 32 Table 6.1 members and four descriptions of use are accounted for as definitions. Blank is a member despite having no ink. Alternative names are not extra characters. The currency graphic and all graphic styles retain their exceptions; glyph obligations stay with S6.1.1-001.

6.1.6.rationale: Optional representability and the occurrence restriction's four permitted contexts are separated. The two ISO-kind internal-record programs are conditional positive controls, not source-decoding, default-repertoire, external-record, glyph or prohibited-context diagnostic evidence. Ten facets remain explicitly pending.

6.3.1.rationale: Composition definitions, both character contexts, both forms, separate applicability, per-unit nonmixing and processor selection are accounted for. Explicit form flags, not filename suffix semantics, select the two forms. The mixed-continuation negative has the one-ampersand repair.

6.3.2.1.rationale: Placement, empty-line permission and the whole-line 10000-character restriction are separated. Eight ASCII raw witnesses have measured boundaries, preserved trailing blanks and external expectations. Comments and blank equivalence do not erase characters from the physical-line limit.

6.3.2.2.rationale: All 28 Table 6.2 entries, four END BLOCK DATA choices, four note separator positions, token/character/FORMAT exceptions and adjacency premises are accounted for. The source locator now assigns the first two sentences to token interiors, leaving blank-run equivalence separate. Reporting permits precisely qualified nonfatal observations without requiring that processor choice.

required_corrections.finding: The inter-token permission and complex-literal illustration form one semicolon-containing sentence; the third sentence belongs to the separate blank-run requirement.
required_corrections.resolution: Corrected first through third sentences to first two sentences and regenerated the view. The 21 affected requirement fingerprints were refreshed, not relabeled as matching the old report.

required_corrections.finding: A gratuitous dollar graphic added an unqualified repertoire premise to the form-selection control; the currency graphic is exempt from the prescribed form.
required_corrections.resolution: Removed the gratuitous dollar entry from the comment and refreshed the input hash and fixture observation. No optional source profile was invented.

raw_boundary_review.counting: All eight selected sources are ASCII with LF record delimiters and no CR. Source-character and byte counts therefore agree; the delimiter is not another source character. Every 10000/10001 pair differs by one byte on line 5.
raw_boundary_review.runtime_oracles: The long valid character assignment checks trimmed length, all x characters, final Z and assignment padding. Other boundary controls check defined value 37 and exact OK output. Invalid sources are never linked or run.
raw_boundary_review.regression_guard: CorpusTests.test_free_form_line_boundaries_are_exact measures all eight witnesses, their pairs and the exact 9990/9991 trailing blanks. Whitespace exceptions apply only to the two deliberate trailing-blank witnesses and the explicitly padded fixed-form input.

reporting_contract.scope: Explicit compile-only manifest opt-in; invalid input with a relevant reporting expectation, not a conforming compile-only program.
reporting_contract.matching: A located error can satisfy the contract at either ordinary process exit status. Nonfatal reports additionally need matching compiler family, severity and a nonempty message predicate. Matching occurs in the diagnostic message, not source echoes or arbitrary output.
preserved_guards: exact line or covering LFortran range
reporting_contract.legacy_policy: Ordinary isolated negatives and manifest reject expectations retain their rejection semantics. No global warning allowance or fabricated warning code is introduced.
reporting_contract.migration_proof: Every moved source is byte-identical to its reviewed author-commit blob. All 81 execution IDs are preserved. All 241 pre-existing execution fingerprints remain unchanged.
additional_repairs: A context-only location cannot be reused for a subsequent unlocated driver error.
Ordinary isolated-negative reports now retain actual command/return-code/stream traces and staged input hashes.
Successful compile-only and link-only references are labeled compiles and links; TEAM remains one compile step with no runtime claim.

source_only_cases.S6_3_2_1_001_invalid__comment_10001: The measured 10001-character comment exceeds 6.3.2.1 p1. Commentary's lack of interpretive effect does not waive the physical-line restriction. The one-character-shorter repair succeeds; selected-configuration acceptance with empty output does not make the source conforming.
source_only_cases.S6_3_2_1_001_invalid__trailing_10001: The assignment and its 9991 trailing blanks form a 10001-character physical line. Blank-run equivalence does not remove the 6.3.2.1 count. The one-blank-shorter repair succeeds; unanimous recorded acceptance does not replace the source oracle.
source_only_cases.S6_3_2_2_003_invalid__character_constant: 6.3.2.2 p2 requires a separator between PRINT and its character-literal constant operand. Both the character-context and 4.2 p3 format-specification exceptions concern the interior/value, not the outer keyword/constant gap. The single-space repair is legal; all recorded processors accept the missing gap without a captured report.

remaining_observations: LFortran's ISO-kind internal READ passes IOSTAT but fails the independently prepared middle-field oracle; both references pass.
Selected LFortran runs miss three overlong-line reports, the PRINT/character-constant gap, the labeled-DO separator, and SELECT RANK's required keyword gap.

The valid BLOCK DATA spelling control is rejected at its opening, masking later end-spelling variants. The valid CRITICAL control exposes target and Flang failures; GNU corroborates the source. Crashes are never diagnostic successes.
Ten additional-character facets still need qualified source-interface or external-record evidence. The existing ISO-kind profile is not evidence of source decoding or graphic appearance.

Two external UTF-8 record facets can use the existing byte-preserved manifest/oracle machinery once the record convention and documentary qualification are established; no generic new profile loader is required merely to express them.
